tasks.label: Diagnose TCP 3001
tasks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (!$c) { Write-Output 'NO_LISTENER' } else { foreach ($x in $c) { $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $x.OwningProcess); Write-Output ('PID=' + $p.ProcessId); Write-Output ('NAME=' + $p.Name); Write-Output ('COMMANDLINE=' + $p.CommandLine); Write-Output ('PARENT_PID=' + $p.ParentProcessId) } }"

tasks.label: Inspect TCP 3001
tasks.command: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $c) { Write-Output 'NO_LISTENER' } else { foreach ($x in $c) { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $x.OwningProcess); Write-Output ('PID=' + $p.ProcessId); Write-Output ('NAME=' + $p.Name); Write-Output ('COMMANDLINE=' + $p.CommandLine); Write-Output ('PARENT_PID=' + $p.ParentProcessId) } }

tasks.label: Verify CleanCity HTTP response
args: fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3002').then(async response => { console.log('HTTP', response.status); console.log((await response.text()).includes('/src/main.tsx') ? 'Vite app entry served' : 'Unexpected page content'); }).catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; })

tasks.label: GitHub: verify account and init
args: Set-Location 'D:\bin\CleanCity'; git init; if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { gh auth status } else { 'GH_CLI_NOT_FOUND' }; git status --short --branch
